financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: In April 2024, the Company sold 1,000,000 shares of its common stock pursuant to the ATM Program, resulting in gross proceeds to the Company of approximately $5.4 million ($5.3 million net of offering costs).

In May 2024, the Company sold 2,690,853 shares of its common stock pursuant to the ATM Program, resulting in gross proceeds to the Company of approximately $15.6 million ($15.3 million net of offering costs).
